title: ESA Astronaut Sophie Adenot Returns to Earth After Record European Mission
summary: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot has returned to Earth after 237 days aboard the International Space Station, the longest spaceflight by a European astronaut so far. She now begins recovery and readjustment to life on Earth.

sections.heading: A Long Stay in Orbit
sections.body: Sophie Adenot spent 237 days aboard the International Space Station, completing more than 3,700 orbits around Earth. That makes hers the longest mission in space by a European astronaut to date.

sections.heading: Handover and Splashdown
sections.body: After handing over to the incoming Crew-13, Adenot and her Crew-12 crewmates undocked from the station on 7 October. They splashed down off the coast of California the following day.

sections.heading: Readjusting to Life on Earth
sections.body: Adenot is now back in Europe, where she will begin post-flight data collection and rehabilitation. This process helps her readjust to life on Earth after such a long time in space.
